comparison.objective: Heat and scrape three paint patches without damaging adjacent glass.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually aim a heat gun while guiding a scraper through softened paint.
comparison.success_condition: All patches stripped, glass uncracked, tools returned, and arms withdrawn.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual tool use is generic; the tested ability is coordinated heating and scraping, not mechanical adjustment and lock retention under repeated impacts.
